video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Coach Nurse | 10.15.26

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the team's preseason practice and player availability
quotes.excerpt: they're going through a good portions of practice and I think that obviously coaching staff was hoping
quotes.quote: They're going through a good portions of practice and I think that obviously coaching staff was hoping to get them in a game before the opener, just because it's nice to shake off whatever or get to see where they're at in that kind of game rather than trying to see where they're at in a real live one. But it is what it is, long season ahead. Hopefully we'll get them back sooner rather than later.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the coaching staff hoped to get injured players into a preseason game before the opener to see where they are at, but acknowledges it is a long season ahead.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the team's fluid and flexible offensive strategy
quotes.excerpt: I think the plan is again it always is a bit fluid and flexible I think
quotes.quote: I think the plan is again it always is a bit fluid and flexible I think is that we would like to get the majority of them into the second half. I think it's now time to play, go into halftime, come back out and get ready to go again, just again to start with that feels like. And then it's probably fairly short after that, but going through that part of it.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse outlines the plan for preseason rotations, noting he wants to get the majority of players into the second half to simulate real game conditions.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the importance of offensive sets and team organization
quotes.excerpt: it's pretty obvious that that's helpful because you can just get to so many more things
quotes.quote: It's pretty obvious that that's helpful because you can just get to so many more things from offensive sets, lots of special team work and then a lots of end of game work. Being on the same page and organized in late and close games both sides of the ball, which we've been working on pretty heavily is critical. It's something we haven't been nearly as comfortable in the last couple years for sure at this point of the year.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the Sixers are focusing heavily on late and close game situations, admitting the team has not been as comfortable in those moments over the last couple of years.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the 76ers' defensive potential and team identity
quotes.excerpt: we're certainly capable of being a very good defensive team and you're going to have to be
quotes.quote: We're certainly capable of being a very good defensive team and you're going to have to be if you have any visions of going really deep. I'm not sure, I don't want to sit here and say that's going to be our identity. I think that if you had to ask me which one will be better, especially at the start for us, it should be the offensive side.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse believes the Sixers are capable of being a very good defensive team, but admits that offensively they should be better at the start of the season.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the impact of the schedule on team development
quotes.excerpt: this is really the only time the first few days out of the block that we get
quotes.quote: It's a little bit because of both of those things and a little bit because of the schedule too. This is really the only time the first few days out of the block that we get to actually have good long hard physical scrimmages, all these drills, all these lots of stuff going on. And then we play a few games and then we get another break like this, so we get another at least two really good like max effort long days that we can do lots of stuff.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse explains how the current schedule allows for long, high-effort practice sessions between preseason games to help with team development.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the team's positive attitude during training camp
quotes.excerpt: the guys have been amazing as far as just attitude and coaching them
quotes.quote: First of all, it's been a lot of fun. The guys have been amazing as far as just attitude and coaching them. It's been a really fun couple weeks. Again, their energy and their focus and their just desire to try to get better quick has been great and that's always really fun to coach. We've been healthy, somebody mentioned, that's been much more fun than it has been. There's been a lot of things that have made it enjoyable camp.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says training camp has been a lot of fun and notes that the team has remained healthy, which has made the process much more enjoyable this year.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey's growth and defensive development
quotes.excerpt: he's figuring out ways to navigate through things differently, shooting gaps, using physicality
quotes.quote: I don't know if I got anything specific other than he just probably as each week ticks by, he gets a little bit more experienced in the terms of he's seeing more reps. He's figuring out ways to navigate through things differently, shooting gaps, using physicality, whatever he's doing. Once you get more and more reps, you get a little more wily doing that kind of stuff. I know it's only a start of his second year, but I think the combination of his ability, the athleticism, getting from point A to point B on the defensive end enables him to do things of variety of ways.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse sees growth in Tyrese Maxey on the defensive end, noting that more reps are helping him become more wily and effective at navigating plays.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the team's confidence in their prepared packages
quotes.excerpt: we feel I think we feel fairly confident in having a decent package prepared for most situations
quotes.quote: I think we're improving just in general, but back to everybody's questions, I think since the health and since that we feel I think we feel fairly confident in having a decent package prepared for most situations. So I think that's coming along pretty quickly.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the team feels confident in having a decent package of plays prepared for most game situations as they continue to improve.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the team's experience with high-intensity opponents
quotes.excerpt: we already experienced it like at Brooklyn like these got full court and those guys were playing
quotes.quote: We've had those discussions and it's fairly simple and we already experienced it like at Brooklyn like these got full court and those guys were playing their A plus plus plus. I think the coach go for a loose ball at midcourt trying to, like we've talked about we are going to have can we handle that kind of stuff. I thought it was a great little like we talked about it, it happened, we understand it's going to be happening and now we just got to be able to handle it.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the Sixers are preparing to handle high-intensity opponents who play with maximum effort, citing recent experiences against Brooklyn.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the necessity of playing the full 48 minutes
quotes.excerpt: you have to play the full 48. You know the silliest thing anybody can think about is
quotes.quote: You have to play the full 48. You know the silliest thing anybody can think about is, oh, these the records this and we're supposed to be this and this ought to be 25 at halftime, just doesn't happen. Look at the history of the even the great Chicago Bulls teams, they were always in a battle and they went down the stretch. That's what you're a good team because you can make the right plays down the stretch. These teams have great NBA players, they have youth, they have depth, they have athleticism, they have size, they have lots of things and you've got to stay with it for 48 minutes.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse emphasizes that the Sixers must play the full 48 minutes to be a good team, noting that even great teams are always in a battle down the stretch.
